blockdesc-choppingblock: A sturdy stump for hewing logs into beams.
blockhelp-choppingblock-laydown: Lay the log on its side
hewnlog-howto: Sneak + right click a chopping block with it to carry on.
handbook-hewing-howto: Sneak + right click a chopping block with one of these logs, pick the recipe, then cut away the wood marked in orange with an axe, saw, knife or chisel (with a hammer in your offhand).
handbook-hewing-heavyhit: The axe's heavy hit takes three layers off in one blow, but wears the axe faster and can easily take wood the recipe needs.
handbook-hewing-makes-desc: Sneak + right click it with a log to start hewing. Everything you can make on it:
blockdesc-choppingblock-*: A sturdy stump for hewing logs into beams.
handbook-choppingblock-make-text: Place a log standing up, then sneak and hold right click on it with an axe. A few swings and it's a chopping block, made from the same wood as the log.
